planets.name: HD 110113 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 110113 with a 2.54-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 110113 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 110113. Its orbit and size follow Osborn et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
